instruction: A small coiled dragon figurine carved as a single faceted translucent crystal, catching light through its gem-cut scales, wings and tail. Amethyst-purple glassy material with internal sparkle and sharp facets.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE crystal dragon figurine in a faceted translucent gemstone style. A small coiled dragon figurine carved as a single faceted translucent crystal, catching light through its gem-cut scales, wings and tail. Amethyst-purple glassy material with internal sparkle and sharp facets. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
